title: The Uses of Losing
sentences: Competitive sport is one of the few institutions that manufactures loss deliberately.
Half of everyone involved in it is guaranteed to fail in any given week of the season.
The arrangement is usually defended on the grounds that it reliably builds character.
That defence is asserted a great deal more often than it is ever seriously examined.
What losing reliably teaches is that effort and outcome are only very loosely coupled.
Whether this produces resilience or resignation depends almost entirely on context.
A child who loses among adults willing to explain the loss learns one particular lesson.
A child who loses in complete silence learns a different and far more durable one.
The sport itself is identical in both of those cases; the surrounding language is not.
We credit the game with effects that properly belong to the people standing around it.
